name: XlQueryType
description: Specifies the type of query used by Microsoft Excel to populate the query table or PivotTable cache.

constants.name: xlODBCQuery
constants.description: Based on an ODBC data source

constants.name: xlDAORecordset
constants.description: Based on a DAO recordset query, for query tables only

constants.name: xlWebQuery
constants.description: Based on a webpage, for query tables only

constants.name: xlOLEDBQuery
constants.description: Based on an OLE DB query, including OLAP data sources

constants.name: xlTextImport
constants.description: Based on a text file, for query tables only

constants.name: xlADORecordset
constants.description: Based on an ADO recordset query
